summary: Two captured source banks do not replay: q-10252 scaling and q-72747 addition. Sampled mathematics, native grading, rendering, delivery and packaging checks passed. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Apply stated elementary row operations to an augmented matrix and select the resulting matrix from five choices.
reasoning_steps: Apply the operation entrywise including the augmented column
Carry updated rows into a second operation when specified
Compare the whole result with the five-option bank
invariants: Only stated elementary row operations; nonzero scaling and distinct source/target rows
Two-step questions use sequential state, not simultaneous original rows
permitted_variations: Small signed integer entries, occasional zeros, and exact reciprocal scalars
Two or three rows and three or four total columns grounded in source shapes
Any eligible row index or swap pair rather than fixed source row roles
Vary coefficients without requiring cancellation in a predetermined column
Permute option positions and maintain plausible distinct whole-matrix distractors
Matrix renaming is irrelevant and must preserve the mathematical result

source_replay.details: 11 of 13 source cases match mathematical parameters and captured banks where present; canonical has no captured bank. q-10252 bank fails all 12 eligible source-style scaling assignments; q-72747 source profile is missing. Its missing separator may be normalized, but its complete bank is still required. q-10252 key/solution absence is documented, with correct fifth choice independently inferred.

math.details: Exact rational arithmetic reconstructed operations from prompts independently of generation metadata. All 337 generated records have exactly one mathematically correct choice and correct final solution matrix. Captured source keys and final solutions also pass where supplied.

variety.details: 240 independent easy samples cover all three swap pairs, three scaling targets and 19 factors; all survive delivery at captured basis 5361. Forced degenerate values resample without changing preselected roles. Exact five-item batch survives; its two swaps share R1/R2, limiting row-pair coverage. Conditional band-first selection tested with inventory present and excluded; actual learner history/policy unavailable.

scope.details: Requested easy questions use one swap or nonzero scaling. Moderate/hard controls preserve one-addition/two-sequential-operation workloads. No unsupported operator, prerequisite or response type demonstrated. Source completeness is separately failed.

grading.details: Real database-free native grade_field accepts 44 independently correct choices and rejects 176 plausible distractors, including every option of controlled changes. All questions are radio fields; free-entry equivalence is inapplicable.

rendering.details: Actual unmodified UI renders 25 records, including all five batch items, all 17 counterfactuals and all template types. Automated report passes; representative screenshots inspected for notation, controls, solutions and clipping at 1280px viewport.

packaging.details: Python version exactly 3.13.5 matches manifest, packages is empty and imports are standard-library/bundled. Explicit-difficulty CLI output is deterministic and replays after relocation for easy/moderate/hard. No assets or external output paths are required. Package file hashes unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Controlled relevant changes alter expected and graded results; irrelevant matrix renaming preserves them. Position and magnitude strategies tested within each recognizable template and separately on exact batch. One-entry scalar comparison succeeds through intended arithmetic. No incidental shortcut demonstrated in these probes; finite batch does not demonstrate every row role.
